metadata.purpose: VALORANT tactical/Valoplant-style ability visualization and gameplay analysis
metadata.accuracy_note: Approximate fields must be re-verified after patches. Riot's official patch notes/content catalog are authoritative for live changes.
local_amendments: 2026-08-14 Harbor (Patch 11.10 rework): replaced 'Cascade' with 'Storm Surge' (wall -> circle, nearsight+slow); updated 'Reckoning' from a circular stun/knockup to a forward-travelling nearsight+slow wave. Both sizes are unverified estimates. Detected because the live valorant-api agent list no longer contains Cascade.

2026-08-14 Line/wall dimensions: replaced estimated widths and missing lengths for 18 abilities with values from wiki.playvalorant.com. Added min_length_m where the player controls the length (charged or drawn); its absence means the length is fixed and only the direction is chosen. Yoru Fakeout left without dimensions - the wiki documents none, so it draws no area rather than an invented one.

2026-08-14 Pass 2: corrected Sova Recon Bolt (5 -> 30 m radius) and Shock Bolt (5 -> 4 m); reshaped Breach Aftershock, Deadlock Sonic Sensor and Iso Kill Contract from circles/points to their real rectangular areas; added Killjoy Turret and Miks Bassquake cones; added Deadlock Barrier Mesh as a 4-arm mesh; added cast ranges for Gekko Dizzy, Veto Crosscut and Breach Aftershock; flagged Curveball / Guiding Light / Guided Salvo as user-drawn curves. Phoenix Run It Back range is DERIVED from movement speed, not documented.

2026-09-03 Chamber Rendezvous: point -> 18 m teleport-radius circle with 8.5 m placement range (wiki, v9.05). Harbor High Tide and Phoenix Blaze flagged curvable — both are steered while casting; Blaze corrected to 21 m and made fixed-length (it cannot be stopped early). Phoenix Curveball changed from a user-drawn curve to a point: the flash pops where the puck is.

2026-09-03 Full pass against wiki.playvalorant.com Stats tables for all 116 abilities (read in a browser, per page). Radii corrected where the wiki disagreed (Sky Smoke 5->4.15, Orbital Strike 7->9, NULL/cmd 15->42.5, Mosh Pit 4->6.2, Cyber Cage 4.5->3.72, Lockdown 30->32.5, Dark Cover 5->4.1, Poison Cloud 4.75->4.5, Cloudburst 4->3.35, and a dozen smaller ones); inner blast radii added where documented; cast ranges added for map-targeted and placed abilities; offset_m added for areas that spawn in front of the caster (Fault Line, Rolling Thunder, Reckoning, Contingency, Convergent Paths, Fast Lane); Toxic Screen 50->60 m and fixed-length; Barrier Orb 6->10.4 x 1.5 m; Cosmic Divide is an infinite wall; Guided Salvo is a circle at its target rather than a drawn path; Leer is the fixed 10 m eye cast; Prowler, Wingman and Guiding Light get DERIVED speed x time lengths; dashes (Tailwind, High Gear, Lightspeed) get their documented distance. approximate:false now means the wiki lists the value.

2026-09-03 Steered abilities (High Tide, Blaze, Prowler, Guiding Light) are drawn as steered paths: the tip follows the pointer out from the caster with the game turn limit where documented (High Tide 180 deg/s at 25 m/s). Blaze corrected to 1-21 m variable length per fandom infobox.

schema.radius_m: AoE radius; null when not applicable
schema.diameter_m: 2 x radius; null when not applicable
schema.width_m: line/cone width; null when not applicable
schema.approximate: true means verify against current game files before treating as exact
schema.offset_m: metres in front of the caster where a line/wall area begins (negative = behind); 0 or absent means it starts at the caster
schema.infinite: wall: extends without end in both directions through the placed point (Cosmic Divide)
schema.curvable: line/wall: steered while casting, so the planner draws it as a bendable curve whose arc length is the documented length
schema.speed_m_s: projectile speed in m/s; with turn_rate_deg_s it bounds how tightly a steered path can turn
schema.turn_rate_deg_s: maximum steering rate while travelling (game files); degrees per metre of path = turn_rate_deg_s / speed_m_s
